title: Control Path Configuration Schema v2
description: Boolean-only flag catalog with explicit catalog identity, namespaced imports, and optional local environment rules. SaaS mode owns environment rules remotely.

mode.description: Rule authority: 'local' compiles environment rules from this file; 'saas' rejects local environment rules and uses the remote SaaS project.

imports.description: Explicit references to shared flag catalogs. Each key is the import namespace used in SDK and rule references (e.g. platform.emergency_kill_switch).

flags.description: Boolean flag catalog keyed by flag name. Map keys must be unique valid identifiers.

environments.description: Local-mode environment rules only. Invalid when mode is 'saas'. Optional in local mode when no targeting is defined yet.

segments.description: Optional reusable targeting predicates for local-mode rules.

kill_switches.description: Local mode only: per-environment URLs hosting the kill switch file. Omit in SaaS mode — the platform CDN serves kill switches after sync.

artifacts.description: Local mode only: per-environment URLs hosting the compiled artifact (environment rules). Omit in SaaS mode — the platform CDN serves artifacts after sync.

catalog.description: Stable identity for this flag catalog. Used for SaaS sync, imports, and telemetry attribution. Effective id is {namespace}.{id} when a namespace is resolved, otherwise id alone.

namespace.description: Optional domain-boundary prefix (e.g. acme). Explicit here for multi-repo; in monorepos may be omitted when control-path.workspace.yaml supplies it via walk-up. File value takes precedence over workspace.

id.description: Catalog identifier within the namespace (e.g. checkout-service).

saasConfig.description: Non-secret SaaS project identity. Auth tokens and cached artifacts live outside Git.

project.description: SaaS project slug or identifier (e.g. acme/checkout).

api_url.description: Optional Control Path API base URL for self-hosted deployments (catalog sync). Not used for SDK runtime polls.

cdn_url.description: Optional CDN origin for SDK runtime polls (kill switch file and compiled artifact URLs embedded at generate-sdk). Defaults to the platform CDN when omitted.

ast_public_key.description: Optional base64-encoded Ed25519 public key for verifying downloaded AST artifacts.

require_ast_signature.description: When true, downloaded AST artifacts must carry a valid signature.

catalogImport.description: Reference to a shared flag catalog file.

path.description: Path to the imported control-path.yaml, relative to this file.

flagDefinition.description: Boolean flag definition with product semantics and declared metadata.

default.description: Fallback value when no environment rule matches.

kind.description: Product semantics: why this flag exists.

lifecycle.description: Repo-owned lifecycle signal. Defaults to active when omitted.

owner.description: Owning team or individual. Warn when missing.

expires.description: Intended cleanup date. Warn for kind: release when missing.

metadata.description: Free-form team-specific annotations. Must not contain SaaS telemetry.

environment.description: Environment with optional metadata and required rules map.

rules.description: Flag rules keyed by local flag name only. Imported flags must not appear here in consuming service catalogs.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Ordered rules evaluated first-match-wins; unmatched flags fall back to catalog default.

rule.description: Boolean targeting rule. Provide either serve directly or rollout with embedded serve.

when.description: Optional expression. When true (or omitted), this rule is eligible.

serve.description: Boolean value to serve when this rule matches.

reason.description: Optional audit note for why this rule exists.

rollout.description: Boolean percentage rollout. Serves the embedded value to a percentage of matching identities.

serve.description: Boolean value served to the rollout bucket.

killSwitchTarget.description: Where the SDK loads the kill switch file for this environment.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL to the kill switch JSON file (e.g. S3 or CDN).

artifactTarget.description: Where the SDK polls the compiled artifact for this environment.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL to the compiled artifact (MessagePack binary, e.g. S3 or CDN).
